expected_behavior: An unmodified x=[1,2] has gradient [2,4]. Mutating a saved detached alias must increment the shared version and cause backward to raise RuntimeError; there is no legitimate post-mutation gradient reference. A mul_ alias control verifies this version/error contract.
bug_signature: detach().apply_(lambda v:v*10) changes values to [10,20] without increasing the version, then backward incorrectly succeeds with [20,40]. The unchanged control [2,4] is not presented as the correct gradient after mutation.
